user: Which currency is used for SEPA transfers?
answer:
What I did
- Checked Verta’s knowledge base on transfers.

What I found
- SEPA transfers are processed in euros (EUR) and are used to send funds to euro-area banks.  
- They typically reach euro-area banks within one business day.

What happens next
- If you want to make a SEPA transfer, tell me the account, beneficiary and amount and I’ll check your limits and help prepare it.

fragments.text:
Verta tariff schedule
## Transfer fees by type
| Transfer type | Flat fee | Percentage fee |
|---|---|---|
| Internal | EUR 0.00 | 0% |
| SEPA | EUR 0.35 | 0% |
| SWIFT | EUR 15.00 | 0.3% |
| Card payment | EUR 0.00 | 1.2% |

The percentage fee is calculated on the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount.

Transfer limits
## Daily and monthly limits by tier
Outgoing transfer limits are tracked in EUR equivalent, separately per day and
per calendar month. The daily and the monthly remainder are different numbers:
both are computed from the same settled-transactions source, but over
different windows.

| Tier | Daily limit | Monthly limit |
|---|---|---|
| Tier 1 | EUR 5,000 | EUR 50,000 |
| Tier 2 | EUR 20,000 | EUR 200,000 |
| Tier 3 | EUR 100,000 | EUR 1,000,000 |

Transfers
## Transfer types
Internal transfers move funds between Verta accounts and settle instantly.
SEPA transfers reach euro-area banks within one business day. SWIFT transfers
are used for other destinations and settle in one to five business days. Card
payments are outgoing payments to a merchant.

Transfers
## Cut-off times
SEPA transfers submitted after 16:00 CET are processed the next business day.
SWIFT transfers submitted after 14:00 CET are processed the next business day.
Internal transfers have no cut-off.
